evidence: Cato, Agr. 18.7: dē glāreā et calce harēnātō

terms.comment: In Vitruvius also the mixed mortar.

phrases.latin: Calcem cum harēnā miscē; tum aquam adde.
phrases.english: Mix the lime with the sand; then add water.

phrases.latin: Cum ea erit extīncta, tunc māteria ita misceātur, ut, sī erit fossīcia, trēs harēnae et ūna calcis īnfundātur
phrases.english: When the lime has been slaked, let the mortar be mixed so that, if the sand is pit sand, three parts of sand are poured in to one of lime

sources: Lewis & Short: harenatus · Lewis & Short: materia
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 168.
